creative_contract.story_premise: Fred takes the leap to protect a glowing marsh threatened by wild currents, predators and broken lily-pad paths.
creative_contract.player_role: Guide Fred, a frog hero exploring Moonpetal Marsh.
creative_contract.main_objective: Reach the Moonpetal Exit while navigating hazards, catching bugs and completing level objectives.
gameplay_truths: Touch-first steering and labeled action buttons
Earn coins and unlock frog appearances
An optional Golden Egg website flow returns to the start of Level 5
creative_contract.visual_direction: Fred's existing illustrated moonlit marsh, frog character and readable touch HUD.

version.description: Take the leap into Moonpetal Marsh! Guide Fred through a 100-level touch-first adventure filled with lily pads, bugs, currents and marsh predators. Leap over danger, dive beneath surface hunters, munch nearby bugs and boost toward the Moonpetal Exit. Earn coins to unlock frog colors and hero gear, and watch for a helpful fairy every tenth level. Find the hidden Golden Egg and choose whether to share your Game Center player name on the website's hunt leaderboard, then return to the beginning of Level 5. Includes reduced-motion support and no advertising or in-app purchases.
version.promotional_text: Leap, dive, munch and boost through a moonlit marsh as Fred becomes the frog hero every little frog dreams about.
version.whats_new: A golden surprise awaits in Moonpetal Marsh! Fred's superhero Golden Egg has a fresh shine. Find it and choose to share your Game Center name, post as Anonymous, or keep your find to yourself. Then hop back to the start of Level 5. We've also polished Pause and made sure a sleepy hunt website never interrupts your adventure.
version.review_notes: Touch the playfield to steer; use MUNCH, LEAP, BOOST, DIVE/SURFACE and PAUSE. EXIT returns to the title. A fairy appears every tenth level. The optional Golden Egg flow uses Game Center authentication, offers a public-name privacy choice and opens the hunt website. Returning from the reveal starts Level 5 again. No advertising or in-app purchases. Native authentication, website consent and device acceptance for this exact build remain pending; these draft notes are not submission evidence.
version.beta_description: Build 11 validates discovery-only Golden Egg website access, read-only Game Center name review, explicit Public/Anonymous/Don't post choices, secure credential migration, Game Center entitlement, Pause and existing marsh gameplay. Website outages must never block startup or core gameplay.
what_to_test: Fresh and upgrade launch without losing saves or cosmetics
Zero website requests during launch, menu, play, saves, Game Center sign-in/native leaderboards and foreground, including an unavailable website
Pause, background and foreground with touch held
Game Center sign-in success, cancellation and recovery
Golden Egg read-only name review, explicit Public or Anonymous posting, Don't post persistence without automatic retry, Anonymous revocation, saved-discovery recovery and Level 5 restart
Return during a delayed name lookup; no later callback may publish the declined find
Title LICENSES and saved Golden Egg actions do not overlap or pass touches through overlays
Keychain migration and relaunch on a physical device
Gameplay and audio on iPhone and iPad
